definitions.correction_rows: Sampled row occurrences whose accepted student task is correction. Acceptability rows excluded.
definitions.mistake_count: Number of explicit producer edits, not edit distance. Zero requires an exact producer clean-control match.
definitions.distinct_rule_ids: Distinct nonempty producer edit.rule_id values among sampled annotated corrupted correction rows; lower bound when coverage partial.
definitions.distinct_edit_pairs: Distinct exact (original edit span, replacement edit span) strings; NOT whole-sentence pairs and NOT edit distance.
definitions.percentages: 100 * sampled identified correction row/token exposure divided by whole active training row/token denominator.
definitions.distribution_denominator: All identified sampled correction rows in this language, including clean controls and unknown annotations.
definitions.categories: Verbatim explicit corruption_type labels; no inferred spelling/grammar labels.
definitions.annotation_join: Exact (target original sentence, input sentence) join to train-only producer pairs; conflicts unknown.
definitions.limitations: Not a complete whole-corpus correction census. Inherited base and non-DaLA embedded correction instructions lack complete local attribution.

coverage_notes: Inherited Danish source attribution unavailable; these are unknown, not zero.
